name: Client product with a test stage and production

roles.decides: merge to the release branch, release, scope, spend
how a technical task is built
roles.does_not: push to the release branch; touch production

roles.owns: screens, design system, test of each change on the stage
roles.decides: design details inside the agreed design system

roles.owns: the signed scope, their own systems and data
roles.does_not: see internal names or working notes

decision_rights.agent_may: open a change request into the working branch, then stop
prepare the release notes and the checklist, then stop

decision_rights.action: run a paid job (scraping, enrichment, model scoring)
decision_rights.agent_may: show the cost preview; run only after a yes for that run
write the open question into the register
say what replaced it and ask
propose old path and new path, then wait

environments.name: stage
environments.branch: the working branch; a push deploys by itself
environments.deploys: a merge into the working branch

environments.name: production
environments.branch: the release branch; a push also publishes the repository to the client

agents.does: builds a task and opens the change request
puts a change on the stage and runs the checks
prepares the release: notes, checklist, the list of what the client will see
checks a screen against the design file and lists findings
agents.stops_for: a conflict between design file and code

sources.wins_over: task lists in plans and docs
the published design-system page (a mirror), code styles
any number about deals typed by hand

decisions.decision: The signed scope of work is the only scope; the earlier, larger draft is superseded
decisions.why: only the signed document is agreed with the client

decisions.decision: The product database is the only home for business data; sheets, mail and forms are doors into it or copies
decisions.why: two copies of a lead list disagreed

decisions.decision: The design file is the home for design; the published design-system page follows it and never overrules it
decisions.why: replaces an earlier decision that made the published page the home
decisions.replaces: an earlier decision that named the published page

decisions.decision: The client's sales system is on hold: nothing reads from it or writes to it
decisions.why: the client has not given access

decisions.decision: Work happens on the working branch; a push to the release branch publishes to the client and releases production, and only the project lead does it
decisions.why: the repository is delivered to the client with internal paths and names removed

decisions.decision: Inherited template code is reference only: not fixed, not tested, not built on
decisions.why: the new system replaces it part by part
decisions.reopen_when: a reference part is needed in production

decisions.decision: Who decides the score threshold per customer segment

open_questions: When will the client give access to their sales system?
